findings.claim: A managed region that does not round-trip UTF-8 takes a conservative decline, and doctor never prescribes a cure the installer would decline.
findings.counterexample: The decline returned 'exists', which prints '[Totem] pre-commit hook already installed.' while the block stays stale forever (executed: three consecutive runs all 'exists', file unchanged, drift intact, versus 'block-rewritten' on the byte-identical valid-UTF-8 control), and doctor kept warning with the remediation 'totem hook install for pre-commit (the managed block is rewritten in place; ...)' - a permanently inert instruction reachable by one ANSI-editor save that turns the template's em dash at byte 36 into cp1252 0x97, where eject.ts:253-258 and docs/wiki/cli-reference.md:70 report the same class as a skip with a reason.

findings.claim: A hook that does not round-trip UTF-8 is appended to, or has its block regenerated, with every one of its bytes intact.
findings.counterexample: True only when the non-round-tripping bytes are in the trailer; when they are in the managed region the block is not regenerated at all (install-hooks.ts:1580 returned 'exists'), and unlike the pre-push upgrader's decline - disclosed in the very next sentence - that decline was named in no changeset, wiki page, spec or docblock.

findings.claim: The byte-level tests pin the new arms, including the idempotent second run.
findings.counterexample: Neither new decline branch had a test - no fixture made the managed region fail the round-trip (install-hooks.ts:1580) and the upgrader's seven tests contained no Buffer or byte literal to reach install-hooks.ts:2469 - and the idempotence pair (expect(second).toBe('exists') plus unchanged bytes) was the identical observable signature of the intended no-op at :1585 and the decline at :1580, so it could not discriminate the state it was written to pin.

verdict: 0 BLOCKING, 1 MATERIAL, 2 MINOR over 8a35423a (the byte-level fold); all three folded in c3a3ab1f: the non-decoding managed region is REPORTED as a new GitHookAction skipped-non-utf8 with its own line on hook install, init and installEnforcementHooks; doctor classifies the shape non-utf8 with the re-save-or-force remedy through the same exported predicate (ownedTrailerByteStart); both decline branches and the doctor row are pinned; the changeset and both wiki pages name the action and the shape. The leg verified the byte fix end to end through the built dist and established that the block-rewrite arm was lossy at every commit before 8a35423a. The fold adds an action and a doctor shape, so the leg was re-armed on c3a3ab1f (its own deposit).
